mapper.sql: SELECT 'EDHR_WORK_TASK' AS source_id, CONCAT('H',LPAD(CAST(h.id AS CHAR),20,'0')) AS row_order_key, CONCAT('handoff:',h.id) AS business_id, CONCAT('EDHR_WORK_TASK:handoff:',h.id) AS task_key, '批记录' AS task_type, 'eDHR工作任务' AS source, CONCAT(CASE h.task_type WHEN 'QA_REVIEW' THEN 'QA不合格评审' WHEN 'QA_DECISION_HANDOFF' THEN 'QA处置结果交接' ELSE CONCAT(h.task_type,'责任交接') END,' · 活跃订单 ',h.active_order_id,' · ',h.reason) AS detail, CASE WHEN h.due_time IS NOT NULL AND h.due_time <= NOW() THEN '已超期·待接手' ELSE '待接手' END AS status_label, h.create_time AS created_at, h.due_time AS due_at, CONVERT(h.task_type USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AS domain_task_type, CONVERT(h.action_url USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci AS action_url, NULL AS batch_execution_id, NULL AS batch_task_id, NULL AS execution_id, 'ACTIVE_ORDER_HANDOFF' AS business_scope_type, CAST(h.active_order_id AS CHAR) AS business_scope_id FROM mes_active_order_handoff_task h WHERE h.tenant_id=#{q.tenantId} AND h.deleted=0 AND h.task_type IN ('QA_DECISION_HANDOFF','QA_REVIEW') AND h.status='TODO' AND h.notification_only=0 AND FIND_IN_SET(#{q.userId},h.candidate_user_snapshot)>0 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM mes_pro_process_pool_active_order ao WHERE ao.id=h.active_order_id AND ao.tenant_id=h.tenant_id AND ao.deleted=0 AND ao.active_status='ACTIVE')
mapper.select: SELECT r.* FROM (SELECT r.* FROM () r ) r WHERE 1 = 1 LIMIT #{fetchLimit}
mapper.sql: SELECT 'WORK_ORDER' AS source_id, LPAD(CAST(w.id AS CHAR),20,'0') AS row_order_key, CAST(w.id AS CHAR) AS business_id, CONCAT('WORK_ORDER:', w.id) AS task_key, '排产' AS task_type, '待排产工单' AS source, CONCAT_WS(' · ', NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(w.code, CONCAT('^[', CONVERT(UNHEX('090A0B0C0D20C2A0E19A80E28080E28081E28082E28083E28084E28085E28086E28087E28088E28089E2808AE280A8E280A9E280AFE2819FE38080EFBBBF') USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci, ']+|[', CONVERT(UNHEX('090A0B0C0D20C2A0E19A80E28080E28081E28082E28083E28084E28085E28086E28087E28088E28089E2808AE280A8E280A9E280AFE2819FE38080EFBBBF') USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci, ']+$'), ''), ''), NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(i.name, CONCAT('^[', CONVERT(UNHEX('090A0B0C0D20C2A0E19A80E28080E28081E28082E28083E28084E28085E28086E28087E28088E28089E2808AE280A8E280A9E280AFE2819FE38080EFBBBF') USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci, ']+|[', CONVERT(UNHEX('090A0B0C0D20C2A0E19A80E28080E28081E28082E28083E28084E28085E28086E28087E28088E28089E2808AE280A8E280A9E280AFE2819FE38080EFBBBF') USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci, ']+$'), ''), ''), NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(w.batch_code, CONCAT('^[', CONVERT(UNHEX('090A0B0C0D20C2A0E19A80E28080E28081E28082E28083E28084E28085E28086E28087E28088E28089E2808AE280A8E280A9E280AFE2819FE38080EFBBBF') USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci, ']+|[', CONVERT(UNHEX('090A0B0C0D20C2A0E19A80E28080E28081E28082E28083E28084E28085E28086E28087E28088E28089E2808AE280A8E280A9E280AFE2819FE38080EFBBBF') USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci, ']+$'), ''), ''), NULLIF(REGEXP_REPLACE(CASE WHEN w.quantity IS NOT NULL AND w.quantity != 0 THEN CONCAT('数量 ', TRIM(TRAILING '.' FROM TRIM(TRAILING '0' FROM CAST(CAST(w.quantity AS DECIMAL(14,2)) AS CHAR)))) END, CONCAT('^[', CONVERT(UNHEX('090A0B0C0D20C2A0E19A80E28080E28081E28082E28083E28084E28085E28086E28087E28088E28089E2808AE280A8E280A9E280AFE2819FE38080EFBBBF') USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci, ']+|[', CONVERT(UNHEX('090A0B0C0D20C2A0E19A80E28080E28081E28082E28083E28084E28085E28086E28087E28088E28089E2808AE280A8E280A9E280AFE2819FE38080EFBBBF') USING utf8mb4) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci, ']+$'), ''), '')) AS detail, '已确认待排产' AS status_label, w.request_date AS created_at, w.planned_start_time AS due_at, w.code FROM mes_pro_work_order w LEFT JOIN mes_md_item i ON i.id = w.product_id AND i.tenant_id = #{q.tenantId} AND i.deleted = 0 WHERE w.tenant_id = #{q.tenantId} AND w.deleted = 0 AND w.status = 1 AND w.type = 1 AND w.temporary_frozen = 0

SELECT 'WORK_ORDER' AS source_id,LPAD(CAST(w.id AS CHAR),20,'0') AS row_order_key,CAST(w.id AS CHAR) AS business_id,CONCAT('WORK_ORDER:',w.id) AS task_key,'排产' AS task_type,'待排产工单' AS source,COALESCE(w.code,'') AS detail,'已确认待排产' AS status_label,CAST(w.request_date AS DATETIME(6)) AS created_at,CAST(w.planned_start_time AS DATETIME(6)) AS due_at,w.code FROM mes_pro_work_order w WHERE w.tenant_id=#{q.tenantId} AND w.deleted=0 AND w.id=#{businessId} AND w.status=1 AND w.type=1 AND w.temporary_frozen=0 FOR UPDATE
